checklist.title: Operator/DBA explicit approval recorded
checklist.how: Operator confirms metadata-write authorisation out-of-band and records the approval ID in the transition log.

checklist.title: Maintenance window declared and concurrent deploy processes stopped
checklist.how: Stop CI deploy jobs and release pipelines for the database host.

checklist.title: Restorable backup + _prisma_migrations export captured
checklist.how: mysqldump + separate dump of `_prisma_migrations` table; verify restore in a sandbox.

checklist.title: Active baseline SQL hash matches release artifact
Read-only `prisma migrate diff` from target DB to release datamodel
checklist.how: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate diff --from-url "$DATABASE_URL" --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script > /tmp/diff.sql

checklist.title: Classify every difference — only the two retained DEFAULT 'GLOBAL' clauses are accepted
checklist.how: form_contract_versions.scope_key and official_permissions.scope_key are the only expected differences. Any additional delta is a stop condition.

checklist.title: Query migration status; select E1/E2/E3 branch
checklist.how: pnpm migrate:status. If active failed row count == 0 → E1/E3. Else → E2.

checklist.title: Run E1 branch commands in order: status, resolve --applied, status, deploy, deploy
Re-run verification query set to confirm no application-schema or row mutation
checklist.how: Compare structure fingerprint and metadata fingerprint before/after the transition.
